deliver.content:
# Single sign-on login flow

SAML and OIDC sign-in on the customer login page.

- New route /sso/start and /sso/callback
- Sessions last 8 hours, tokens are never stored in the browser
- Callback test covers a wrong audience and an expired assertion
deliver.text: [DONE] The login flow is built and works with both SAML and OIDC. Customers type their company email and are sent to their own identity provider, then land back in the app signed in. The callback has a test for a wrong audience and an expired assertion. Details are in login-flow.md.

deliver.content:
# Threat review: single sign-on

1. Session fixation: rotate the session id after sign-in.
2. Token lifetime: 8 hours, no refresh in the browser.
3. Account takeover through a shared email: match on the verified domain.
4. Replay of an old assertion: check the one-time id.
5. Open redirect after sign-in: allow only our own paths.
deliver.text: [DONE] I found five risks and wrote a fix for each in threat-review.md. The two that matter most are rotating the session after sign-in and matching accounts on the verified company domain. None of them blocks the launch.

content.text: [APPROVE] The session is rotated after sign-in, the callback checks the audience and the test covers an expired assertion.

deliver.text: [DONE] The sign-in screen has one field for the work email and one button, Continue with company account. If the company is not set up yet, we say so in plain words under the field and link to the setup guide.

deliver.content:
# Set up single sign-on

1. Open Settings, then Security, and choose Single sign-on.
2. Copy the sign-in URL and the certificate into Okta or Microsoft Entra ID.
3. Paste your identity provider's metadata back and select Test.
4. Turn on Require single sign-on for everyone.
deliver.text: [DONE] The onboarding guide now has a setup page that covers both Okta and Microsoft Entra ID, with four steps each. I also added a short troubleshooting list for the two errors customers will hit first. The guide is in onboarding-sso-guide.md.
